LanguageData.FB_BileMortarGland.label: bile mortar
LanguageData.FB_BileMortarGland.description: A living artillery gland that grows bileburst podlings and launches mature ones as incendiary shells.
LanguageData.FB_BileMortarGlandEmbryo.label: bile mortar embryo
LanguageData.FB_BileMortarGlandEmbryo.description: An immature bile organ that will grow into a bile mortar.
LanguageData.FB_BileburstPodling.label: bileburst podling
LanguageData.FB_BileburstPodling.description: A living shell that accumulates flammable bile. Can be ordered to crawl to a target and detonate, or be launched by a bile mortar.
LanguageData.FB_BileburstPodling.tools.0.label: soft bite
LanguageData.FB_BileburstPodlingShell.label: bileburst podling shell
LanguageData.FB_BileburstPodlingShell.description: A bileburst podling prepared for a mortar launch. Bursts on impact, scattering flammable bile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonBileBombardment.label: flesh moon bile bombardment
LanguageData.FB_VolatileBileFilth.label: volatile bile
LanguageData.FB_VolatileBileFilth.description: A slick smear of unstable organic bile. It burns readily when exposed to flame.
